title: $888 million for ads: US Republicans ramp up sends to defend 39 House seats once deemed 'safe'
summary_full: Republicans are investing significantly in House races previously deemed secure as they confront emerging electoral challenges. Spending has surged to $888 million in advertising compared to $666 million by Democrats. Economic pressures are impacting traditionally Republican districts and may influence voter sentiments. Republican strategists are concerned about potential losses and are campaigning vigorously. Maintaining their House majority is now a priority for GOP leaders ahead of the elections.
